summary: A field that holds nothing and falls back to something says what it falls back to, so a person can tell «not set» from «set to the same value».

then.note: `inherited` says that a value comes from somewhere else; `inheritedValue` says what it is. Both are needed: a colour inherited from the theme and a colour chosen to match the theme look identical on screen, and only the first follows the theme when the theme moves. A running Larena site inherits fourteen colours this way, which is why the pair exists.
